# eBay

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `core` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 5 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Public shop: public pages captured signed out. Signed-in screens were not captured..

Captured 2026-11-22, signed out (public pages only; login, signup, checkout, and subscribe were not followed). Themes: core.

eBay is a public marketplace. This package is a signed-out capture of [https://www.ebay.com/](https://www.ebay.com/) on 2026-11-22. Desktop width measured 1440 by 900, `devicePixelRatio` 2. The homepage, one public listing, and the empty login and signup walls were photographed. Nothing was typed, submitted, or signed in.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

This is the signed-out marketplace, not a signed-in account. Do not treat the live hero or a listing price as stable chrome.

The wordmark in [icons/mark.svg](icons/mark.svg) is a reconstruction in Arial. It is not the Market Sans logo file.

`--color-blue-500` matches the Search fill. The other sampled custom properties were not seen as live states.

Phone width was not captured. Menus were not opened. Hover and focus were not measured.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Keep the search pill blue.** The Search control is the only filled accent on the header. [screenshots/home-light-1440.png](screenshots/home-light-1440.png)
- **Leave identity providers alone.** Google, Apple, and Facebook sit under the form and were not used. [screenshots/login-light-1440.png](screenshots/login-light-1440.png)
- **Stop at the empty walls.** Login asks for email first. Signup asks for name, email, and password, and Create stays disabled while empty. [screenshots/signup-light-1440.png](screenshots/signup-light-1440.png)
